summary: Implemented the decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (standard library only, with private helper _resolve_decathalon_path). Exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry after the Utilities automodule in docs/source/data.rst. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels, each removing its temp directory in a finally block. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and black/flake8 are unverified. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: invalid JSON, a missing key, and a non-list key value raise ValueError; image and label are resolved only when present; base_dir is typed Optional[str].
